name: Rolls 2
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Add beaten whites of 2 eggs, 1/2 cup sugar, and 1/4 cup butter to one pint of bread sponge
Mix well and set in a warm place to rise
Roll out to a thickness of 1/4 inch
Butter top of one and place another on top
Currants may be added if desired

source.originalInstructions:
1. Add beaten whites of 2 eggs, 1/2 cup sugar, and 1/4 cup butter to one pint of bread sponge
2. Mix well and set in a warm place to rise
3. Roll out to a thickness of 1/4 inch
4. Cut out with cake cutter
5. Butter top of one and place another on top
6. Set aside to rise
7. Bake for one-half hour
8. Currants may be added if desired
